profile_text.body:
OpusClip is a video repurposing tool that, according to its own site, turns long videos into short clips intended for social media distribution and publishes them across platforms in a single step. The company describes itself as the number one AI video clipping and editing tool and states it serves more than 10 million creators. Its pipeline analyzes video content against social and marketing trends from major platforms to identify highlight moments, which are then rearranged into shorter clips and polished with dynamic captions, AI-based relayout, and smooth transitions.

The company's primary AI product is ClipAnything, which it describes as the only AI clipping model capable of handling any video genre, including vlogs, gaming, sports, interviews, and explainer videos, in contrast to competing tools it characterizes as limited to video podcasts. ClipAnything processes visual, audio, and sentiment cues throughout a video and also accepts natural language prompts to target specific moments. OpusClip also offers an AI reframe model that resizes video for different platforms and uses object tracking to keep moving subjects centered, with a manual tracking option for additional user control.

The held facts confirm OpusClip is tracked under the video generation and editing category, with its core product listed under the same name and focused on video repurposing. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
